text: MessageTagProperties is reused for both changedProperties and oldProperties in onUpdated, so omitted properties mean unchanged fields rather than a complete tag snapshot. The original landing assigned accountsRead to onDeleted, while the fixed accepted schema requires messagesTagsList for all three tag lifecycle events. Use the current permission when reviewing new consumers. Full permission discussion is unread, and this comparison does not establish the reason for the later correction.
title: Use the shared tag-property bag for update payloads and document permission changes
